title: BINI sings ‘Sama-Sama Tayo’ in tribute to PH's ASEAN Chairship
summary: BINI lends its voices to 'Sama-Sama Tayo,' a song unveiled by the Department of Tourism as a tribute to the Philippines’ journey as ASEAN Chair.
